TermTranslation.definition: A test that uses a hollow tube with a light and camera to look at or treat the colon.

TermTranslation.term: â nitûchischâyimâkiniwit awân misinâpiskihîkinishiyiu â pîhchipiyihtâkiniwiyich utichishîhch
TermTranslation.public_note_en: an examination with a camera inserted into the colon
